variant: A: Table capacity and service turns

domain_invariants.requirement: Table, service-shift, and seating ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive ids are not found. Persisted dates are ISO-8601 dates from 2025-01-01 through 2035-12-31 and timestamps are offset-aware UTC ISO-8601 values in that range.
A table has a unique uppercase code matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]{0,11}$, zone in INDOOR, TERRACE, BAR, PRIVATE, seats 1..20, active boolean, and no deletion flag exposed as active.

A service shift has service_date, service_kind in BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER, start_at and end_at on the same service_date, end_at later than start_at, and turn_count 1..4. A service_date and service_kind pair is unique.

A seating references one active table and one shift, has party_size 1..20 not greater than table seats, turn_number 1..shift.turn_count, guest_name trimmed 2..120 characters, and status BOOKED, SEATED, COMPLETED, or CANCELLED.
For each non-cancelled seating, table_id, shift_id, and turn_number are unique. A table can therefore serve at most its own seat capacity in a turn and exactly one party in each selected turn.
Seating transitions are BOOKED to SEATED or CANCELLED, and SEATED to COMPLETED or CANCELLED. COMPLETED and CANCELLED are terminal; completed seating retains table, shift, and party history.
A table can be deactivated only with no BOOKED or SEATED seating. A table or shift can be soft-deleted only with no seating of any status; deletion never cascades to seating history.

Users may create and read only seatings created by their own account and may update or cancel only their own BOOKED seatings. Admins manage tables and shifts and may access every seating. Private access is denied by default.

All standard lists use ascending immutable numeric id order, limit 1..100 default 20, optional after_id greater than zero, and items plus nullable next_after_id. Filters are applied before the cursor, preserving stable pages.
Each write is atomic: on validation, authorization, uniqueness, capacity, or transition failure it rolls back all changes and leaves tables, shifts, and seating relations unchanged.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; all other endpoints require a valid non-expired local Bearer session and deny by default.
Seed data provides two user accounts, one admin account, active tables of several capacities, and future LUNCH and DINNER shifts with different turn_count values.
JSON write endpoints require application/json; malformed JSON returns 400, an unsupported media type returns 415, and valid JSON failing declared validation returns 422.
The API is deterministic and local: persistence failure returns 503 and unexpected local failure returns 500 without any persistent effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization, probe only local persistence, make no persistent change, and emit only 200 or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetHealth(request):
    // REQ-4-011; preconditions: none; authorization: public.
    IF local persistence is unavailable THEN RETURN 503. END IF
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors have no side effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /tables to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional zone, min_seats 1..20, active boolean, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-002 and REQ-4-009, return a stable page without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListTables(request):
    // REQ-4-012; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE filters and REQ-4-009 OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ matching non-deleted tables by id; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition and errors leave state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /tables to an admin, accepting JSON code, zone, seats, and optional active default true; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-002, atomically create a unique table, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /tables/{table_id} to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive table_id; it shall apply REQ-4-001, return the non-deleted table without persistent effects, and emit only 200, 401, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetTable(request, table_id):
    // REQ-4-014; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401; IF table_id is non-positive, absent, or deleted THEN RETURN 404. END IF
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: persistent state unchanged; errors do not modify it.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /tables/{table_id} to an admin, accepting a positive table_id and JSON code, zone, seats, or active; it shall require application/json, validate the result under REQ-4-002 and REQ-4-007, atomically update supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, preserve seating relations, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /tables/{table_id} to an admin, accepting a positive table_id; it shall atomically soft-delete only a table with no seating records under REQ-4-007, be idempotent only insofar as a deleted id is 404, not cascade to shifts or seatings, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /service-shifts to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional service_date, service_kind, date_from, date_to, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-003, ordered inclusive date filters, and REQ-4-009, return a stable page without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListShifts(request):
    // REQ-4-017; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE dates, enum, range, and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ matching non-deleted shifts by id; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition and errors leave persistent state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /service-shifts to an admin, accepting JSON service_date, service_kind, start_at, end_at, and turn_count; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-003, atomically create the unique shift, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /service-shifts/{shift_id} to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive shift_id; it shall enforce REQ-4-001, return the non-deleted shift without effects, and emit only 200, 401, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetShift(request, shift_id):
    // REQ-4-019; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401; IF shift_id is non-positive, absent, or deleted THEN RETURN 404. END IF
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors leave all relations unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /service-shifts/{shift_id} to an admin, accepting a positive shift_id and JSON start_at, end_at, or turn_count; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-003 and existing seating turn numbers, atomically update only a shift with no seating records, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, preserve all relations on failure, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /service-shifts/{shift_id} to an admin, accepting a positive shift_id; it shall atomically soft-delete only a shift with no seating records under REQ-4-007, be idempotent only insofar as a deleted id is 404, not cascade to tables or seatings, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /seatings to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional positive table_id, positive shift_id, status, service_date, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-004, and REQ-4-009, restrict users to caller-created seatings, return a stable page without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListSeatings(request):
    // REQ-4-022; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE filters and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422; unknown supplied table or shift is 404.
    READ matching rows by id, constrained to creator for user under REQ-4-008; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; state unchanged on every result.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /seatings to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON positive table_id, positive shift_id, turn_number, party_size, and guest_name; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-004 through REQ-4-005, atomically create a BOOKED seating owned by the caller after locking capacity, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /seatings/{seating_id} to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive seating_id; it shall enforce REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-008, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetSeating(request, seating_id):
    // REQ-4-024; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401; RETURN 404 for non-positive or absent id; REQUIRE creator or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: state and table-shift relation unchanged on errors.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /seatings/{seating_id} to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive seating_id and JSON guest_name, party_size, table_id, shift_id, or turn_number; it shall require application/json, permit only BOOKED seatings, validate resulting REQ-4-004 and REQ-4-005 constraints, atomically update supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /seatings/{seating_id}/cancel to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive seating_id and JSON cancelled_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001, permit BOOKED or SEATED transitions only under REQ-4-006, atomically mark CANCELLED while retaining table and shift history, be non-idempotent, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.
